name: What is considered a legal tiny home for placement on a lot in California?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a legal tiny home for placement on a lot in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: In California, a legal tiny home can be classified in several ways, often as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU) if on a residential lot with an existing primary home. Alternatively, it might be a park model RV or a manufactured home on a foundation in designated areas. The specific classification depends on its foundation, wheels, and local zoning ordinances. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in ADU-compliant tiny homes, ensuring they meet state and local building codes for permanent placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: A legal tiny home in California is often an ADU or JADU, or a manufactured home, depending on its foundation and local zoning.
